# David Liew — Field Log

> A field log of the AI era: dated notes on four decades of tech shifts — pre-internet, internet, mobile, cloud, now AI — and on raising kids through them. Written for future me first; others overhear.

## About

David Liew is based in Singapore. Product Deployment Engineer at Google gTech Ads (Search+); previously Meta (Technical Solutions Consultant). This site is a personal field log, not a portfolio or a course.

## Structure

- / — the log: framing plus latest entries
- /log/ — full archive, at two speeds: notes (fast observations) and essays (occasional longer pieces)
- /log/what-this-log-is — the log's contract
- /about/ — professional background and contact links

## Frozen archive

Curriculum pages written in 2025–2026 (/ai-journey/, /context-engineering/, /agents/, /vibe-coding/, /teaching, /hackathons, /contact) remain reachable at their URLs but are frozen: no longer maintained, linked, or listed in the sitemap.
